input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img6 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0006.png')
# Let's find all pixels of the floor lamp base disc
# It is grey: around [70-100, 65-95, 60-90], distinct from floor [130, 144, 152]
# and distinct from blue vase [115, 52, 18] (BGR)
base_pixels = []
for y in range(315, 330):
    for x in range(340, 380):
        c = img6[y, x]
        if 65 <= c[0] <= 105 and 60 <= c[1] <= 100 and 55 <= c[2] <= 95:
            base_pixels.append((x, y))

if base_pixels:
    xs, ys = zip(*base_pixels)
    print(f'Floor lamp base disc in obs_0006: x=[{min(xs)}, {max(xs)}], y=[{min(ys)}, {max(ys)}]')
    print(f'Center estimate: x={np.mean(xs):.1f}, y={np.mean(ys):.1f}')
"
